summary: summarize SKILL.md Prompt Rewrite — P0 constraint adherence fix
approach: Restructure SKILL.md to put Constraints first with ALL CAPS emphasis, add output example with [§N] citations and ≤30% demonstration. Zero code changes.

design_decisions.title: Section ordering: Constraints → Purpose → Working Principles → Patterns → Quality Bar
design_decisions.rationale: Primacy effect — LLMs weight earlier content more heavily. Constraints must be the first thing the model reads.
alternatives: Keep existing order (Purpose → Principles → Constraints → Patterns → Quality Bar)
Constraints at both top and bottom
design_decisions.chosen: Constraints first, single placement at top

design_decisions.title: Emphasis strategy: ALL CAPS + bold
design_decisions.rationale: ALL CAPS and bold text in system prompts significantly increase LLM compliance with specific rules (well-documented prompt engineering practice).
design_decisions.chosen: ALL CAPS for critical constraints + bold for section headers
design_decisions.note: Avoid XML tags — they may interfere with some model tokenizers

design_decisions.title: [§N] citation — separate section + example
design_decisions.rationale: [§N] is a custom format with zero model training data. It needs its own section AND a worked example to establish the pattern.
design_decisions.chosen: Both — dedicated rule section + example output

patterns: Philosophy: Skill is a prompt package — SKILL.md is the executable instruction
conventions: ALL CAPS for MUST/MUST NOT rules
Example output uses real content to demonstrate format
